items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And what was it, Eugene Spencer -- I mean, whoever, whatever his band was at that time, you know. He had augmented his small group.

ctx.x: And sang, yes. And had marvelous arrangements. His pianist was a kid by the name of Specs, used to call him Spencer. Jesse Simpkins was the bass player, Oliver what's that drummer, and they had a vibes, someone played vibes. But a very, very entertaining band. At this time I was working with my mother, Dan Grissom and I was working with my mother.
You said that Ray had great arrangements. Was Ray arranging or --
